The agentic OS for manufacturing.

Manufacturing still runs on people carrying work between documents, decisions and the ERP. Weftwerk hands that work to teams of AI agents on one deterministic core: the agents bring judgement, the core enforces every check, guardrail and record, and nothing is committed without a person’s approval.

Six workflows every plant runs.

Outside worldAgentsA person signsPosted to the ERP
What arrives

An email, a PDF purchase order, the buyer’s own spreadsheet or a phone photo — often from a repeat buyer who writes “same as last time”.

What the agents do

Read every field, resolve the ambiguous ones against the buyer’s order history and the contract price list, check credit, stock and capacity, and draft the sales order showing where each field came from.

Where a person signs

A price below list waits for the sales head. A new buyer, or an order over the credit limit, waits for finance, with the PO and price list beside it.

What is posted

The sales order in SAP; at dispatch, the e-invoice and e-way bill. A confirmation to the buyer and a note to production. Amendments carry who asked and why.

What arrives

The buyer’s email order — usually a line or two from a repeat buyer — and, later, the draft letter of credit from their bank.

What the agents do

Draft the proforma and export contract in SAP. Read the LC clause by clause and flag any term the documents could not meet, so the buyer amends it before it is final. Then prepare every shipping document to its terms.

Where a person signs

The export desk releases the proforma and every presentation to the bank. Finance releases the realisation entries.

What is posted

Proforma, commercial invoice, packing list and certificate of origin, each recorded in SAP; shipping-bill data to the customs agent; the LC and its amendments on file against the order; the presentation set to the bank.

What arrives

Supplier invoices by email, chat message or phone photo, in every layout a supplier can produce.

What the agents do

Extract the invoice and match it to the purchase order and goods receipt line by line, with the quality result beside it. Prepare the posting; a debit note where quantity or price differ; a hold where the GST credit is not yet reported.

Where a person signs

Accounts approves anything that did not match. A new supplier bank account needs two approvers.

What is posted

The vendor invoice in SAP with GST reconciled, ready for the payment run; the debit note to the supplier where a line disagreed.

What arrives

Bank statements daily; vendor and customer statements as they come; the statutory filing calendar.

What the agents do

Match by rules first, judge the odd narration second. Reconcile vendor, customer and GST balances, tie TDS to the tax portal, prepare the filings, draft the accruals and consolidate the statements for the close.

Where a person signs

Finance approves every filing, and every entry that needed a judgement call.

What is posted

Reconciled ledgers and accruals in SAP, filings ready to submit, and the MIS pack.

What arrives

Confirmed orders, stock positions and machine availability from SAP; a line stoppage or a late material from the floor.

What the agents do

Run the requirements plan, build a finite-capacity schedule, re-plan the machine allotment when a frame stops or a material slips — showing which orders moved and why — and raise the maintenance notification when the floor reports a fault.

Where a person signs

The planner releases production orders, and any plan that moves a buyer’s date.

What is posted

Production orders, confirmations and maintenance notifications in SAP; the plan to the floor.

What arrives

Delivery challans at the gate, supplier test certificates with the lot, and count sheets from the stores.

What the agents do

Read the certificate against the specification, record the inspection result, reconcile counts to book stock, raise the non-conformance with the certificate and the test result attached, and draft the material-master change when a new grade arrives.

Where a person signs

Quality releases or rejects the lot. The plant head and finance approve any stock adjustment.

What is posted

Goods receipt, inspection result and stock adjustments in SAP; the non-conformance to the supplier.

Six of hundreds.A plant runs hundreds of workflows like these. We take them one desk at a time, each measured before the next, on the same OS and under the same sign-off.

Who signs, and where the data stays.

What leaves your environment

A data-processing agreement covers every customer, and your records are deleted when you leave. SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits are pending. Personal data is handled under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act.

Who signs

Routine work is confirmed at the desk. Above a limit you set, a second approver signs. Per workflow, per company.

Audit trail

Every field traces to a document, a rule, or a person and a time. The whole trail replays, in order, for your auditor.

Rate, line 12sales head · 09:15
Pause switch

Stop one agent, one team or everything. The ERP is untouched; work waits.

Payment runpaused by you
Kept apartYour records are held separately from every other customer’s, under their own keys.
Nothing kept by the model providerIt receives what one step needs and stores none of it. Nothing is trained on your data.
Encrypted throughoutIn transit and at rest. The most sensitive fields are encrypted a second time.
The same rights as the personAn agent can do only what the signed-in person may do. The trail shows who confirmed.
Documents cannot give ordersText inside a PO or an email cannot make anything happen in SAP. A person confirms every write.
Never posted twiceAfter a timeout, the system checks what reached SAP before it tries again.

What it changes.

Across the industry

For one company

  • O2CAn emailed order becomes a sales order the same morning, every field traced to the PO.
  • EXIMLetter-of-credit discrepancies are caught before the documents reach the bank.
  • P2POnly the invoices that fail the three-way match reach a person.
  • R2RMonth-end starts from books that were reconciled every day.
  • PPThe plan is redone the same day a frame stops or a material slips.
  • IM · QMEvery lot is checked against its test certificate at the gate.
